cases.expect: Satisfying distinct-day readings does not bypass a separate final-form publication wait.
The current final bill form is evaluated; reading an old draft is not availability of amended text.
CA crisis declaration without the required governor statement and actual house waiver does not remove the 72-hour rule.
TX ordinary versus general-appropriations and regular versus special session select their own sourced waits.
Three calendar-legislative days are not silently counted as 72 elapsed hours; use a verified unit evaluator.
An eligible bill without scheduling/decisions does not magically progress every three days; an eligible scheduled bill need not wait an extra arbitrary three days.
The Ohio statutory reading rule is used only where applicable, not forced on every charter government.
Employer withholding and employee settlement cannot charge the same Philadelphia wage liability twice.
A valid municipal levy amendment changes its own instrument only; state/federal and another locality stay unchanged.
The dated 2025 versus 2026 Philadelphia rows apply to their correct represented periods.
A credit uses its actual local ordinance and previously paid liability, not a universal full-credit assumption.
Reopen, Save/Continue and larger time advances do not duplicate votes, waivers, enactments or collections.
